text:
jamie: quick heads-up — planning a small tf apply in the Thurs change window to tighten a service-account policy (no resource renames). aiming for low-risk but want clear rollback rules.

alex: which module/PR?

jamie: https://git.internal/repo/infra/compare/feature/sa-policy-tighten — change is in modules/iam/service-accounts.tf, ~10 lines.

alex: saw the diff, looks non-destructive (deny extra actions). still: need to confirm no cross-account role bindings get removed.

maya: will we canary? prefer staging -> single AZ prod -> full. also need smoke for any auth paths.

jamie: yes — canary plan: apply to staging (all checks), then prod canary in us-west-2 only (tagged hosts), then full prod.

sam: security note: confirm this does not touch KMS policies or key grants. if it does, hold and we need key-owner approval.

alex: confirmed — only iam:PassRole and iam:AssumeRole policy tighten on one SA. no KMS touched.

ops-bot: @deploybot preflight results attached — plan ok, no resource replacements, 0 -> 0 deletions, 2 policy documents changed. (CI link: https://ci.internal/build/9876) :white_check_mark:

jamie: roll forward plan and rollback criteria below.

alex: post the exact rollback steps pls so SRE can ops-doc them.

jamie: short checklist:
- preflight plan ran green (ops-bot).
- on-call (maya) watches metrics for 10m after canary apply.
- if auth failures >= 1% of login attempts OR any service 5xx spike > baseline+20% for 10m -> trigger rollback.
- rollback = `terraform apply` with previous module tag (v1.4.2) — we pin module and run rollback apply.

maya: suggest adding quick user-test: run `make smoke-auth` against a tagged canary instance after apply. If smoke fails, rollback immediately.

jamie: good — added. also: we will pin provider and module versions in the canary workspace to avoid drift.

deploybot: scheduling change window: 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z -> queue created. To confirm run: react with :white_check_mark:. Preflight log: https://deploy.internal/preflight/1772509876

alex: slight tweak — add a short downtime message to release notes and set feature flag rollback path (just in case).

sam: approve from sec side. stamp: APPROVED (no KMS).

jamie: ok all — final steps:
1) alex merges PR and tags module v1.5.0-canary
2) deploybot runs staging workspace apply (auto).
3) if staging green -> prod canary in us-west-2.
4) after 10m successful smoke -> prod full.

maya: i'll be on standby during the window. i'll post a short runbook link once alex merges.

alex: merging now, tagging canary, kicking off preflight.

ops-bot: deploybot queued job started: job id 5552. plan output snippet:
```
  # aws_iam_policy.example will be updated in-place
  ~ resource "aws_iam_policy" "svc_ext_policy" {
      policy = jsonencode({
        - "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
        + "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
      })
    }
```

jamie: thanks — will update release notes and post runbook. react :thumbsup: once you see the canary go.

maya: :thumbsup: watching.

deploybot: staging apply completed at 2026-03-24T22:14:00Z — no errors.

alex: starting prod canary apply (us-west-2 tagged).

ops-bot: prod canary apply finished at 2026-03-24T22:35:30Z — smoke auth run OK on tagged instance.

maya: metrics look clean so far (no auth spikes). holding 10m then proceed.

jamie: proceed to full prod in 5m unless anyone objects.

sam: no objections. go.

ops-bot: full prod apply started.

deploybot: full prod apply success. rollout complete. Release notes updated: https://docs.internal/release/2026-03-24/entry-549

jamie: great job. closing thread.
